name: Incomplete DataLayer on the Thank you page
description:
# Context

We published a dataLayer package [https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shoptet/datalayer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shoptet/datalayer) from which the documentation is generated. We have found out that it's missing some values. Some are added [https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/13022/files](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/13022/files), but overall this part (thank you page) is not covered with the nigh test.

# Task

- Investigate and add all mising values from [backend](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/blob/0d485bd6fa6191820cae473d8156d34de9cb9f4a/cms/packages/Google/GoogleTagManager.php). `discountCoupons` is missing to name one example
- extend the [night test spec](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/blob/97fb25568f911c4d35c9cb5b9f8decd7de2db8f7/cypress_tests/cypress/tests/functional/common/data_layer.spec.js) to test Thank you page
